glossary_feedback.observation: The guide uses 'referral platform' for the system a patient app or CBO app connects to, which includes referral-source EHRs (e.g., Epic) as well as coordination platforms. The glossary has no generic term for 'the referral source's or intermediary's FHIR-serving platform'.

Self-referral uses 'Community Resource Platform' as a named actor acting as the referral source system. The glossary only mentions 'community resource referral platform' as an alias of CP and inside the referral source definition; no entry says whether this platform is a CP or the referral source's system.

'Patient/Client' is used for a person using an app, while 'client' also means software; the glossary's Patient definition already covers 'client' in the person sense. Self-referral also uses 'Individual/Patient' as a paired role name.

System actions by the referral target and referral source (e.g., 'the CBO's system processes the received Task', 'the CBO updates the Task', 'the Community Resource Platform polls') have no glossary system-actor term; left unchanged per the domain note (see D-11).

Enrollment defines 'Provider' as 'the healthcare entity or clinician', mixing organization and person, while the glossary defines Provider as a person and the roles table labels the organization as 'Healthcare Provider'.
